simple_fishing_overhaul.config.catchRadi: Radius in blocks around the bobber in which fish can be caught.
simple_fishing_overhaul.config.intrigueC: Chance for fish to get intrigued by the bobber and move towards it. The Lure enchantment increases this chance by up to 2 times.
simple_fishing_overhaul.config.intrigueR: Water surface area around the bobber where fish can become intrigued by it. The Lure enchantment increases this radius by up to 1.67 times.
simple_fishing_overhaul.config.intrigueD: Depth in blocks under the bobber where fish can become intrigued by it. The Lure enchantment increases this value by up to 3.34 times.
simple_fishing_overhaul.config.lureBonus: How much Lure should affect the intrigue chance and radius.
simple_fishing_overhaul.config.intrigueR: How often in ticks (20 ticks = 1 second) fish near a floating bobber get another chance to become intrigued by it.
Multiplier applied to the intrigue chance for the repeated rolls after the bobber first lands.
simple_fishing_overhaul.config.minIntere: Shortest time in ticks an intrigued fish stays interested in the bobber.
simple_fishing_overhaul.config.maxIntere: Longest time in ticks an intrigued fish stays interested in the bobber.
simple_fishing_overhaul.config.boredTick: Time in ticks a fish ignores bobbers after losing interest or getting away.
simple_fishing_overhaul.config.intrigued: How much more likely an intrigued fish is to be chosen to approach the bobber. Closer fish are also preferred.
simple_fishing_overhaul.config.maxApproa: Time in ticks a fish has to reach the bobber before it gives up and another fish can be chosen.
simple_fishing_overhaul.config.arrivalDi: Distance in blocks from the spot under the bobber at which an approaching fish bites.
simple_fishing_overhaul.config.minRelure: Shortest wait in ticks before a new fish can approach after an approach fails.
simple_fishing_overhaul.config.maxRelure: Longest wait in ticks before a new fish can approach after an approach fails.
simple_fishing_overhaul.config.castCharg: Allows charging the fishing rod cast to control the distance of the cast.
simple_fishing_overhaul.config.minCastDi: Controls the closest distance the cast can reach when charging.
simple_fishing_overhaul.config.maxCastDi: Controls the farthest distance the cast can reach when charging.
simple_fishing_overhaul.config.netherite: Enables the Netherite Fishing Rod, obtained by upgrading a fishing rod in the smithing table.
simple_fishing_overhaul.config.fishDropN: Prevents fish from dropping any loot when killed.
simple_fishing_overhaul.config.allowFish: Allows fishing in waters with no fish inside to obtain junk or treasure.
simple_fishing_overhaul.config.protectRe: Fish released from a bucket cannot be caught with a fishing rod. Named fish are always protected.
simple_fishing_overhaul.client_config.ca: Displays a casting bar in the hotbar when charging the cast.
simple_fishing_overhaul.client_config.cu: Enables a unique first person animation for charging the cast.
Enables a unique third person animation for charging the cast.
